data.name: Ismaael
data.gender_notes: Ismaael is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: God heard and answered our prayer. Ismaael is the name of Ibrahim's (Abraham) son, born in response to God's promise that Ibrahim would father a son in his old age. When Ibrahim was about to sacrifice his son Ismaael as a test of his faith, God intervened and provided a ram as a substitute. Ismaael is also known as Ishmael.
data.spiritual_meaning: A test of faith and obedience to God.
data.etymology: Ismaael belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God heard.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ismaael total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: إسماعيل
in_arabic.long_meaning: إسماعيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: الله يسمع و يستجيب الدعاء، و هو من الأسماء التي ذكرت في القرآن الكريم، و هو اسم سيدنا إسماعيل عليه السلام، ابن سيدنا إبراهيم عليه السلام، و يعتبر إسماعيل من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: اسماعیل
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ سنتا ہے اور دعا قبول کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسماعیل ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ سنتا ہے اور دعا قبول کرتا ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور یہ سیدنا اسماعیل عليه السلام کا نام ہے، جو سیدنا ابراہیم عليه السلام کے بیٹے تھے، اسماعیل نام اسلامی تقليد میں بہت اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: इस्माइल
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान सुनता है और प्रार्थना स्वीकार करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: इस्माइल एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है भगवान सुनता है और प्रार्थना स्वीकार करता है, यह नाम कुरआन में उल्लेखित है, और यह हज़रत इस्माइल का नाम है, जो हज़रत इब्राहिम के पुत्र थे, इस्माइल नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: اسماعيل
in_pashto.meaning: الله اورېږدي او دعا مېنځته كوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسماعيل د عربي اصل نوم دی چې مطلب يې دے الله اورېږدي او دعا مېنځته كوي، دا نوم په قرآن كريم كې ذكر شوی دی، او دا د حضرت اسماعيل نوم دی، چي د حضرت ابراهيم زوی و، اسماعيل نوم په اسلامي دود كې ډير مهم ګڼل كېږي

in_english.name: Ismaael
in_english.meaning: God hears and responds to prayer
in_english.long_meaning: Ismaael is an Arabic name derived from the root 's-m-'l', meaning God hears and responds to prayer. The name Ismaael is mentioned in the Quran and refers to the Prophet Ismaael, son of Prophet Ibrahim. In Islamic tradition, Ismaael is considered a significant name due to its association with the prophets and its etymological connection to divine communication.

data.cultural_impact: Ismaael is a significant figure in Islamic history, as he is considered the ancestor of the Arab people through his son, Predjad. He is revered for his patience, obedience, and devotion to his father, especially during the trial of the Akedah (sacrifice) when Ibrahim was tested to sacrifice him.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ismaael carries a deep spiritual meaning as it symbolizes God's promise to answer the prayers of His faithful servants. It highlights the importance of faith, obedience, and sacrifice, and serves as a reminder that even in times of hardship and adversity, God is always present and listening. It also represents God's mercy and compassion, as He protected Ismaael from being sacrificed and provided a substitute instead.

Prophet Ibrahim was commanded by Allah to leave his wife Hajar and his infant son Ishmael in the desert of Mecca, between Safa and Marwa.
